newsitem.title: CYPRUS: SOCCER-TOP CYPRUS SCORER GOGIC MOVES TO OLYMPIAKOS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TOP CYPRUS SCORER GOGIC MOVES TO OLYMPIAKOS.

text.p: Top Cyprus scorer Sinica Gogic of Anorthosis has been transferred to Greece's Olympiakos Piraeus for $750,000, Cypriot newspapers reported on Monday.
The 33-year-old striker, a Serb with Cypriot citizenship, started his career in Cyprus with the APOEL club of Nicosia in 1989. He moved to Anorthosis Famagusta a year later.
A five-times player for Cyprus's national team, Gogic said the transfer did not mean he was abandoning Cyprus.

"I have signed a 2.5 year contract with Olympiakos (Piraeus) but I do not believe when that expires my career will too," he said. "I believe I can play for another year and I want to end my career in Cyprus."
Gogic is currently the top scorer in the Cyprus league with 14 goals. He was named player of the year twice, in 1990 and 1994.
Another Cypriot international, Costas Malekkos, 25, was transferred to Greece's Panathinaikos last week from Omonia Nicosia for $350,000.
